concepts.gloss_en: Servant/slave (singular) — a bechinah of the cursed (Canaan 'servant of servants'), and the moon called 'servant'

members.note: representative; singular, denotes the archetypal 'servant' bechinah (Canaan, arur, the moon)

concepts.gloss_en: Servants/slaves (plural) — referring variously to the premises/introductions of the wisdoms and to the four elements' evil traits

members.note: representative; plural used for the 'introductions of all wisdoms' (lm1:4) and the four elements (lm1:64)

notes: Singular עבד and plural עבדים are kept separate: they are not mere orthographic number-variants of one concept but are applied to genuinely different referents across the cited usages (singular = archetypal servant/moon/Canaan; plural = premises of wisdoms / four elements). Under-merge preferred per protocol. Note both share 'מבית עבדים' proof context but the surface forms differ (עבד vs עבדים).
